name: Wrist Rotation
description: Extend arms forward, make fists and rotate both wrists in full circles — inward then outward.

name: Wrist Flexion & Extension
description: Place palms together in front of your chest, then reverse (backs of hands together) and push gently.

name: Wrist Figure-Eight
description: Interlace fingers and draw continuous figure-eight patterns with both hands. Keep wrists loose.

name: Arm Circle
description: Extend arms to the side. Draw large forward circles for 10 s then reverse for 10 s.

name: Shoulder Roll
description: Roll both shoulders forward in large circles for 10 s, then backward for 10 s.

name: Cross-Body Arm Swing
description: Swing both arms across your chest simultaneously, then open them wide. Increase range each rep.

name: Plank
description: Hold a forearm plank position. Keep your core tight and back flat.

name: Mountain Climber
description: Start in a high plank. Drive alternating knees toward your chest rapidly.

name: Dead Bug
description: Lie on your back, arms up and knees at 90°. Slowly lower opposite arm and leg toward the floor, then return.

name: Squat
description: Feet shoulder-width apart, squat until thighs are parallel to the floor, drive through heels to stand.

name: Lunge
description: Step forward with one leg, lower your back knee toward the floor, return to standing. Alternate legs.

name: Lateral Shuffle
description: Wide stance, stay low. Shuffle 3 steps left then 3 steps right in an athletic position.

name: Hip Circle
description: Feet shoulder-width apart, hands on hips. Draw large circles with your hips, alternating directions.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch
description: Step into a lunge, drop the back knee to the floor, and push hips forward gently. Hold 10 s each side.

name: Leg Swing
description: Hold a wall for balance. Swing one leg forward and back in a controlled arc, then switch sides.

name: Cat-Cow
description: On all fours, alternate between arching your back toward the ceiling (cat) and dropping your belly toward the floor (cow).

name: Thoracic Rotation
description: Sit cross-legged, hands behind your head. Rotate your upper body left then right, keeping hips still.

name: Standing Side Bend
description: Feet hip-width apart, raise one arm overhead and bend to the opposite side. Hold 5 s, then switch.

name: Jumping Jack
description: Start with feet together and arms at sides. Jump feet apart while raising arms overhead, then return.

name: High Knees
description: Jog in place, driving knees as high as possible. Pump arms in opposition.

name: Butt Kicks
description: Jog in place, kicking your heels up to touch your glutes with each step. Keep a quick pace.

name: Burpee
description: From standing: squat down, jump feet back to plank, do a push-up, jump feet in, jump up with arms overhead.

name: Bear Crawl
description: Start on all fours with knees hovering 2 cm off the floor. Crawl forward 3 steps then backward 3 steps.

name: Inchworm
description: Stand and hinge at the hips to place hands on the floor. Walk hands out to a plank, then walk them back and stand.
